performance_case.causal_mechanism: A causally frozen D-1 expiry-futures inventory followed by complete confirmed D-day futures and index atoms may reveal derivatives crowding before a later BTC spot DRA admission decision, but only if a minimal isolated package can execute the frozen two-phase evidence chain without importing Trading runtime behavior.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This read-only audit may freeze only a package and launcher architecture plus an exact later implementation file inventory. It cannot prove build success, deployment, server enforcement, endpoint reliability, source registration, first future evidence, prediction, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any future drawdown reduction remains MISSING_PROOF until lawful prospective carry evidence supports a separately preregistered matched-capital Validation and sealed OOS result.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A narrow closure audit prevents either shipping broad application classes into the Research Worker or spending server and Local Research capacity on a package whose CLI, installer and verification inventories cannot close together; it temporarily defers a new economic hypothesis by one bounded infrastructure slice.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The package audit cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly, but a minimal executable carry evidence path can reduce time to a credible accept-or-reject test of one primary-supported mechanism while avoiding deployment and evidence-integrity failures.
